verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes a documented public RESTful API for live register data, with a get-started guide and dedicated authorisation, rate-limiting and versioning guides. A probe confirmed a real endpoint that returns a structured auth challenge, meaning it works with free registered keys rather than sitting behind a bot wall. Missing for 10: evidence that write actions (filing accounts, changing registered office) can be driven through the API rather than only GET retrieval, a stable non-beta versioned API (resources are held at 'version 0'), and agent-oriented docs such as llms.txt.
